overview: Colla IV is a outer rim territories world documented across the nine saga films, live-action and animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, and Old Sith Empire records.
history:
Colla IV appears in records spanning the Old Republic, Clone Wars, Imperial era, Galactic Civil War, and Legacy periods. Archaeological surveys, holocrons, and veteran testimony preserve its place in galactic history.

Strategic value, cultural identity, and Force-sensitive traditions on Colla IV shifted with each regime—from Sith occupation to Republic restoration and beyond.
significance: Colla IV remains a reference point in Outer Rim Territories surveys, trade lane charts, and military campaign planning across the nine saga films, series, KOTOR, and the Old Sith Empire.
